value.behaviour: Initialize pages, activePageId, and pageViewports in getDefaultAppState() and configure storage/export behavior in APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF and cleanAppStateForExport.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME from @excalidraw/common.
2. In getDefaultAppState(), initialize pages: [{ id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME }], activePageId: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, and pageViewports: {}.

3. In APP_STATE_STORAGE_CONF, add pages: { browser: true, export: true, server: true }, activePageId: { browser: true, export: true, server: false }, and pageViewports: { browser: true, export: true, server: false }.

4. In cleanAppStateForExport(appState), call _clearAppStateForStorage(appState, "export") and if appState is the untouched single default page ((!appState.pages || (appState.pages.length === 1 && appState.pages[0].id === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID && appState.pages[0].name === DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME)) && (!appState.activePageId || appState.activePageId === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID) && (!appState.pageViewports || Object.keys(appState.pageViewports).length === 0)), delete pages, activePageId, and pageViewports from the returned object so single-page exports remain identical to legacy exports.

value.behaviour: Isolate undo and redo stacks per page in History so undoing or redoing only affects the active page.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID from @excalidraw/common.

2. Replace the single undoStack and redoStack arrays on History with private activePageId: string = DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, private readonly undoStackByPage = new Map<string, HistoryDelta[]>(), and private readonly redoStackByPage = new Map<string, HistoryDelta[]>(), and provide public get undoStack(): HistoryDelta[] and public get redoStack(): HistoryDelta[] getters that return (and lazily initialize) the array for this.activePageId.
3. Add public setActivePageId(pageId: string): void that sets this.activePageId = pageId || DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and triggers onHistoryChangedEmitter with the new page's stack emptiness.
4. Add public deletePageHistory(pageId: string): void that deletes pageId from undoStackByPage and redoStackByPage.
5. In clear(), clear both undoStackByPage and redoStackByPage maps.

value.behaviour: Restore multi-page and legacy single-page drawings in restoreElementWithProperties, restoreAppState, and restore.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME from @excalidraw/common and withElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.

2. In restoreElementWithProperties, update the generic constraint to Required<Omit<ExcalidrawElement, "customData" | "pageId">> & { customData?: ExcalidrawElement["customData"]; pageId?: ExcalidrawElement["pageId"] }, and only set base.pageId when element or extra has a non-empty string pageId (deleting any empty/invalid pageId from ret).

3. In restoreAppState, validate and normalize nextAppState.pages (if missing or empty array, default to [{ id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME }]; for each page entry, ensure a non-empty unique string id and trimmed non-empty string name defaulting to `Page ${index + 1}`), normalize nextAppState.activePageId (falling back to pages[0].id if missing or not found in pages), and normalize nextAppState.pageViewports (keeping valid page entries with finite scrollX, scrollY, and normalized zoom, and if appState.scrollX/scrollY/zoom were not explicitly provided on appState, applying pageViewports[activePageId] when present).

4. Export const restore = (data: ImportedDataState | null, localAppState?: Partial<AppState> | null, localElements?: readonly ExcalidrawElement[] | null, elementsConfig?: { refreshDimensions?: boolean; repairBindings?: boolean; deleteInvisibleElements?: boolean }): RestoredDataState that restores appState and elements and assigns any element whose pageId is missing or not in appState.pages to appState.pages[0].id via withElementPageId.

value.behaviour: Serialize all pages and their elements in serializeAsJSON for both local and database exports of multi-page drawings.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID from @excalidraw/common and getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.

2. In serializeAsJSON(elements, appState, files, type), if (appState as any)?.__allElements is a function and elements === (appState as any)?.__activeElements, use (appState as any).__allElements() as sourceElements; otherwise use elements.

3. Determine isMultiPage = Boolean((appState.pages && appState.pages.length > 1) || (appState.pages && appState.pages.length === 1 && (appState.pages[0].id !== DEFAULT_PAGE_ID || appState.pages[0].name !== "Page 1")) || sourceElements.some((el) => el.pageId && el.pageId !== DEFAULT_PAGE_ID)).

4. When isMultiPage is true, map sourceElements so each element includes pageId: getElementPageId(el) for both type === "local" and type === "database"; when type === "local" ensure appStateForExport includes pages, activePageId, and pageViewports (merging the current activePageId's scrollX, scrollY, and zoom into pageViewports if present on appState), and when type === "database" ensure clearAppStateForDatabase(appState) includes pages so shareable link and Excalidraw+ database exports serialize the full multi-page drawing.

sites.rule: Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID from @excalidraw/common and getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.
Serialize all pages' elements and multi-page appState metadata in serializeAsJSON for both local and database targets.

value.behaviour: Filter visual exports (SVG, canvas, PNG, clipboard) to render only the active page's elements while embedding all pages' elements when embedScene is enabled.
rules: 1. Import DEFAULT_PAGE_ID from @excalidraw/common and getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.

2. In configExportDimension, restore allRestoredElements first, restore appState, and filter elements to those matching activePageId = data.appState?.activePageId || appState.activePageId || DEFAULT_PAGE_ID whenever data.appState?.activePageId is supplied or allRestoredElements contains elements from more than one page, returning both elements (active-page filtered) and allRestoredElements.

3. In exportToSvg when config?.embedScene is true, pass allRestoredElements and data.appState ?? appState to serializeAsJSON so embedded scene metadata preserves all pages while the rendered SVG only draws the active page's elements.

Filter elements for visual export to the active page while keeping allRestoredElements for embedded scene serialization.

Destructure allRestoredElements from configExportDimension in exportToSvg.

value.behaviour: Preserve element pageId and per-page ordering when reconciling remote and local elements during collaboration.
rules: 1. In reconcileElements, when selecting remoteElement over localElement, if remoteElement.pageId is undefined and localElement?.pageId is defined, preserve pageId: localElement.pageId on the reconciled element.

2. Because orderByFractionalIndex, validateFractionalIndices, and syncInvalidIndices (from U04) operate per pageId group when multiple pages exist, reconcileElements reconciles and orders elements across all pages without cross-page index collisions.

sites.rule: Preserve localElement.pageId when remoteElement omits pageId.
